# @jewel998/config — Complete Documentation

> Free, self-hosted feature flag and remote configuration SDK. Replaces LaunchDarkly at $0/month. Runs entirely on Firebase free tier.

- GitHub: https://github.com/jewel998/config
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jewel998/config
- Docs: https://jewel998.github.io/config/
- License: Elastic License 2.0

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install @jewel998/config
```

---

## Quick Start (Frontend / Client-side)

```typescript
import { initConfig, autoContext } from "@jewel998/config";

const flags = initConfig({
  clientId: "cid_xxx",           // From Portal → API Keys
  baseUrl: "https://your-project.web.app/api",
  defaults: {
    "feature.dark_mode": false,
    "app.upload_limit": 50,
    "feature.new_checkout": false,
  },
  context: autoContext({ userId: "user_123", plan: "pro" }),
});

// Instant read — returns default before API responds
flags.get("feature.dark_mode"); // → false

// After API resolves
flags.on("updated", ({ keys }) => {
  flags.get("feature.dark_mode"); // → true
});
```

## Quick Start (Server-side / Backend with local evaluation)

```typescript
import { createConfig } from "@jewel998/config";
import { targetingPlugin } from "@jewel998/config/targeting";
import { rolloutPlugin } from "@jewel998/config/rollout";

const config = createConfig({
  clientId: "svr_xxx",
  baseUrl: "https://your-project.web.app/api",
  plugins: [targetingPlugin(), rolloutPlugin()],
  context: { userId: "user_123", attributes: { plan: "pro", country: "US" } },
});

config.getFlag("feature.checkout_v2"); // Evaluated locally — no round-trip
```

---

## Concepts & Glossary

- **Config / Feature Flag** — A key-value pair that controls application behavior at runtime. Types: boolean, string, number, JSON, array.
- **Context** — User attributes sent to the API for evaluation (userId, plan, country, etc.).
- **Segments** — Reusable audience groups defined by conditions on context attributes.
- **Targeting Rules** — Rules matching context or segment membership to return specific values. Evaluated in priority order.
- **Rollouts** — Percentage-based gradual release using deterministic hashing (MurmurHash3).
- **Prerequisites** — Flag dependencies where Flag B requires Flag A to meet a condition.
- **Scheduling** — One-shot time-based flag activation at a specific date/time.
- **Environments** — Isolated deployment stages (dev/staging/prod) with independent configs.
- **API Keys** — Client keys (cid_) = server-side evaluation. Server keys (svr_) = client-side evaluation.
- **Evaluation Pipeline** — Order: archived → prerequisites → overrides → schedule → targeting → rollout → default.
- **Loading Strategies** — optimistic (instant defaults), pessimistic (blocks until fetch), deferred (manual trigger).
- **Circuit Breaker** — Stops requests for 5 min after fatal errors (401/403).
- **RBAC** — Viewer (read), Editor (read/write configs), Admin (full access).

---

## SDK API Reference

### initConfig(options) → Flags

Primary entry point. Returns instant defaults, resolves to real values in background.

#### InitConfigOptions

| Property       | Type                  | Default             | Description                                    |
| -------------- | --------------------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| clientId       | string                | (required)          | API key from Portal (cid_ or svr_)             |
| baseUrl        | string                | Demo instance URL   | Your self-hosted Firebase API URL              |
| defaults       | Record<string, any>   | {}                  | Fallback values returned instantly             |
| context        | EvaluationContext     | {}                  | User context for targeting                     |
| pollInterval   | number                | 300000 (5 min)      | Version poll interval ms (0 to disable)        |
| storage        | CacheStorage          | memoryStorage()     | Cache adapter                                  |

#### Flags methods

| Method       | Signature                          | Description                               |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| get          | <T>(key: string) => T              | Get a flag value (default until resolved) |
| flag         | (key: string) => boolean           | Get boolean flag (false if missing)       |
| all          | () => Record<string, unknown>      | Get all values                            |
| setContext   | (ctx: EvaluationContext) => void   | Update context (triggers re-fetch)        |
| refresh      | () => Promise<void>                | Force re-fetch from API                   |
| on           | (event, callback) => void          | Subscribe to events                       |
| off          | (event, callback) => void          | Unsubscribe                               |

### createConfig(options) → ConfigClient

Advanced entry point with full control over loading, plugins, and caching.

#### CreateConfigOptions

| Property          | Type                                          | Default        | Description                              |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| clientId          | string                                        | (required)     | API key (prefix determines eval mode)    |
| loadingStrategy   | "optimistic" | "pessimistic" | "deferred"    | "optimistic"   | How data is loaded on init               |
| fetchGranularity  | "batch" | "projected"                       | "batch"        | Fetch all keys or only requested ones    |
| storage           | CacheStorage                                  | memoryStorage  | Cache adapter                            |
| plugins           | EvaluationPlugin[]                            | []             | Client-mode evaluation plugins           |
| context           | EvaluationContext                             | {}             | User context                             |
| retry             | RetryConfig                                   | 3 retries      | Retry config for failed fetches          |
| timeout           | number                                        | 10000          | Pessimistic mode timeout (ms)            |
| baseUrl           | string                                        | Demo URL       | Custom API endpoint                      |
| consentAware      | boolean                                       | false          | GDPR mode: defaults until consent        |

#### ConfigClient methods

| Method       | Signature                            | Description                              |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| getValue     | <T>(key: string, default?: T) => T   | Get a typed config value                 |
| getFlag      | (key: string) => boolean             | Get boolean flag                         |
| getAll       | () => Record<string, unknown>        | Get all key-value pairs                  |
| refresh      | () => Promise<void>                  | Version-gated re-fetch                   |
| setContext   | (ctx: EvaluationContext) => void     | Update context                           |
| on/off       | (event, callback) => void            | Event subscription                       |
| destroy      | () => void                           | Cleanup timers and state                 |

### EvaluationContext

```typescript
interface EvaluationContext {
  userId?: string;
  attributes?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[]>;
  consentGranted?: boolean;
}
```

### autoContext(overrides?)

Auto-detects browser/device attributes and merges with provided overrides.

Detected attributes: browser, browserVersion, os, device, screenWidth, screenHeight, locale, timezone.

```typescript
import { autoContext } from "@jewel998/config";
const ctx = autoContext({ userId: "user_123", plan: "pro" });
```

### mergeContext(base, overrides)

Deep-merge contexts. Override values take precedence.

```typescript
import { autoContext, mergeContext } from "@jewel998/config";
const context = mergeContext(autoContext(), { userId: "user_123", attributes: { plan: "pro" } });
```

| Export Path                      | Description                    |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| @jewel998/config                 | Main SDK (initConfig, etc.)    |
| @jewel998/config/server          | Server utilities               |
| @jewel998/config/storage         | Memory storage adapter         |
| @jewel998/config/targeting       | Targeting evaluation plugin    |
| @jewel998/config/rollout         | Percentage rollout plugin      |
| @jewel998/config/schedule        | Scheduling plugin              |
| @jewel998/config/prerequisites   | Flag prerequisites plugin      |
| @jewel998/config/lifecycle       | Lifecycle hooks plugin         |
| @jewel998/config/overrides       | Local overrides plugin         |
| @jewel998/config/management      | Management API client          |

---

## Events

| Event        | Payload                                                    | Description           |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| ready        | { loadingStrategy, cachedKeys }                            | SDK initialized       |
| updated      | { keys: string[], source: "background"|"refresh"|"version-check" } | Values changed |
| fetchError   | { error, retryCount, willRetry }                           | Fetch failed          |
| revoked      | { clientId, message }                                      | API key revoked       |

---

## API Key Types

| Prefix | Type   | Use In              | Behavior                                              |
| ------ | ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| cid_   | Client | Frontend            | API evaluates targeting server-side, returns values   |
| svr_   | Server | Frontend (advanced) | Returns full flag data for local evaluation           |

---

## Loading Strategies

### Optimistic (default)

Instant init with defaults/cache. Background fetch. Emits "updated" on resolve.

```typescript
const flags = initConfig({ clientId: "cid_xxx", defaults: {...} });
flags.get("key"); // → default (instant)
flags.on("updated", () => { /* re-render */ });
```

### Pessimistic

Blocks until API responds or timeout.

```typescript
const config = createConfig({
  clientId: "cid_xxx",
  loadingStrategy: "pessimistic",
  timeout: 5000,
});
await config.ready();
config.getFlag("key"); // → real value
```

### Deferred

No network until you trigger manually.

```typescript
const config = createConfig({
  clientId: "cid_xxx",
  loadingStrategy: "deferred",
});
// Later:
config.setContext({ userId: "user_123" });
await config.refresh();
```

---

## Storage & Caching

### memoryStorage() (default)

Does not persist across reloads. Lost on page unload.

### browserStorage(options?)

Persists in localStorage across page reloads and tabs.

```typescript
import { initConfig, browserStorage } from "@jewel998/config";
const flags = initConfig({
  clientId: "cid_xxx",
  storage: browserStorage({ prefix: "myapp", defaultTtl: 86_400_000 }),
});
```

Options: prefix (string, default "@jewel998/config"), defaultTtl (number, default 7 days in ms).

### Custom CacheStorage interface

```typescript
interface CacheStorage {
  get<T>(key: string): T | undefined;
  set<T>(key: string, value: T, ttl?: number): void;
  delete(key: string): void;
  clear(): void;
}
```

---

## Segments

Reusable audience groups defined by conditions on user context attributes. Define once, reference in targeting rules across many flags.

### Condition Logic (DNF)

- Conditions within a group = AND
- Groups connected by OR

### Supported Operators

equals, not_equals, contains, starts_with, ends_with, in_list, not_in_list, greater_than, less_than, regex_match

---

## Targeting Rules

Rules evaluated in priority order. First match wins. Two types:

1. Segment-based (recommended) — pick segments, assign value
2. Condition-based (advanced) — custom attribute conditions

### Evaluation Pipeline Order

1. Archived → 2. Prerequisites → 3. Overrides → 4. Schedule → 5. Targeting Rules → 6. Rollout → 7. Default

---

## Percentage Rollouts

Deterministic bucketing: `MurmurHash3(flagKey + ":" + userId) % 100`

- Same user always gets same bucket for a given flag
- Different flags give different buckets
- Increasing percentage is additive (existing users keep the feature)
- Requires userId in context

---

## Prerequisites

Flag dependencies. "Feature B only active if Feature A meets condition."

Operators: equals, not_equals, greater_than, less_than, contains.

Circular dependency protection: self-reference detected, circular chains broken, max 5 levels deep.

---

## Scheduling

One-shot time-based flag activation. Once activateAt time passes, scheduled value is returned permanently.

Priority: Prerequisites → Overrides → **Schedule** → Targeting → Rollout → Default.

---

## Environments

Fully isolated deployment stages. Each has own configs, API keys, targeting rules, domain restrictions.

---

## Team & RBAC

| Role   | Configs    | Segments   | API Keys | Settings | Team |
| ------ | ---------- | ---------- | -------- | -------- | ---- |
| Viewer | Read       | Read       | Read     | Read     | Read |
| Editor | Read/Write | Read/Write | Read     | Read     | Read |
| Admin  | Full       | Full       | Full     | Full     | Full |

---

## Webhooks

Real-time HTTP notifications on config changes. Supports: Slack, Discord, Google Chat, MS Teams, custom templates.

Filters: event types, resource categories, environments.

Custom templates use {{variable}} syntax with dot-notation access.

---

## Audit Log

Every portal change recorded: actor, action, resource, timestamp, old/new values, diff viewer.

---

## Import / Export

Import: CSV or JSON. Conflict resolution: skip, overwrite, review.
The portal writes imports directly to Firestore (no Cloud Function needed).
Export: Full project or user-specific (GDPR Article 20). 24-hour download links. Uses the `exportConfigs` cloud function.

---

## Cloud Functions (Deployed)

| Function          | Trigger                 | Purpose                                     |
| ----------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| getConfig         | POST /api/v1/config     | Deliver resolved config values to SDK       |
| getVersion        | GET /api/v1/version     | Lightweight version check for polling       |
| validateSignIn    | Before user sign-in     | Enforce access control                      |
| onAuditCreated    | Firestore trigger       | Dispatch webhooks                           |
| exportConfigs     | Callable                | Export project data as JSON                 |
| testWebhook       | Callable                | Send test payload to webhook URL            |

### POST /api/v1/config

Request:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "clientId": "cid_xxx",
    "context": { "userId": "user_123", "attributes": { "plan": "pro" } }
  }
}
```

Response (cid_ key):
```json
{
  "data": { "feature.dark_mode": true, "app.upload_limit": 200 },
  "version": "3",
  "timestamp": "2025-01-15T09:30:00.000Z"
}
```

Response (svr_ key):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "feature.dark_mode": { "key": "feature.dark_mode", "value": false, "targetingRules": [...] }
  },
  "segments": { "seg_beta": { "id": "...", "conditions": [...] } },
  "version": "3"
}
```

Error codes: 400 BAD_REQUEST, 401 UNAUTHORIZED, 403 FORBIDDEN, 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

### GET /api/v1/version?clientId=cid_xxx

Response:
```json
{ "version": "43", "changedKeys": ["feature.dark_mode"] }
```

Supports If-None-Match → 304 if unchanged.

---

## Error Handling

The SDK never throws. Errors emitted via "fetchError" event.

```typescript
flags.on("fetchError", ({ error, willRetry }) => {
  console.warn("Config fetch failed:", error.message);
});
```

### Circuit Breaker

CLOSED → normal | OPEN → blocks 5 min after 400/401/403 | HALF_OPEN → probes after cooldown.

### Rate Limit Handling

429 responses include Retry-After header. SDK waits the specified duration.

```typescript
import { RateLimitError } from "@jewel998/config";
flags.on("fetchError", ({ error }) => {
  if (error instanceof RateLimitError) {
    console.warn(`Retry in ${error.retryAfterSeconds}s`);
  }
});
```

---

## Self-Hosting

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jewel998/config && cd config
firebase use --add your-project-id
pnpm install
pnpm --filter @jewel998/config-portal run build
firebase deploy --force
```

Requirements: Node.js 22+, pnpm 9+, Firebase CLI, Firebase Blaze plan.

### Cost

| Scale              | Monthly Cost | Notes                                   |
| ------------------ | ------------ | --------------------------------------- |
| 1–1,000 users      | $0           | Within Firebase Spark free tier         |
| 1,000–50,000 users | $0           | CDN handles most polls at edge          |
| 50,000–100,000     | $0–5         | May exceed free function invocations    |
| 100,000+           | $5–15        | Blaze plan with minimal overage         |

---

## Performance

- Region match (functions + Firestore) = most important factor
- CDN cache hit: 10-50ms
- Warm function, same-region: 100-200ms
- Cold start: 2-4s (eliminate with MIN_INSTANCES=1, ~$3-5/mo)
- Use browserStorage() to eliminate API calls on return visits
- Version polling checks 100-byte response every 5 min

---

## Architecture

```
App (SDK) → Firebase Hosting CDN → Cloud Function (getConfig) → Firestore
Portal (React SPA) → Firestore (direct reads/writes with security rules)
```

## Monorepo Structure

```
apps/portal/    — Admin portal (React + Vite + TanStack Router)
apps/landing/   — Marketing site (Astro + React)
apps/docs/      — Documentation (VitePress)
packages/api/   — Internal micro-framework for Cloud Functions
packages/config/ — SDK (@jewel998/config)
packages/tour/  — Tour framework
functions/      — Firebase Cloud Functions
```

---

## Comparison vs Competitors

- vs LaunchDarkly: $0/month vs $10+/user/month. Self-hosted. Same core features.
- vs Firebase Remote Config: Targeting rules, segments, rollouts, audit log, RBAC.
- vs Unleash: No Docker/Postgres. Firebase-native. Free tier handles most apps.
